Current reserves: Money 67623, Influence 49, Operations 11, Boost 244.5, Water 797, Volatiles 539, Metals 1385, Noble Metals 14, Fissiles 0, Exotics 0.

ALIEN INCURSION ADVISORY: 1 visible alien councilor; active xenoforming is visible in 38 regions (highest activity: Salta at level 49.7); 0 visible alien facilities. Direct alien-councilor detection: ONLINE.
